transcript: The first step on the healing path of traditional Chinese medicine is to understand the nature of your inner climate, whether you carry a hot constitution or a cold one. This is not a small question. Your constitution is the compass that tells you which foods nourish you and which quietly drain your strength. If your body is a cold constitution, it means the fire of yang has grown dim. You feel cold easily. Your hands and feet lose warmth. Your blood moves slowly. Your energy feels soft and tired. You may even find yourself running to the bathroom often, the body trying to release what it cannot transform. How does one fall into coldness? By living too long under the breath of the air conditioner, by filling the stomach with raw juices, iced drinks and foods that cool the flame of life. So the remedy is simple but powerful. Bring warmth back into the palace of the body. Eat cinnamon to awaken the channels. Ginger in the morning to stir the inner fire. Lamb, black beans, warming soups. All these remind the yang to rise again and avoid the cold guests. Sushi, salads, ice and anything that steals temperature from your core. Walk gently my friend. Tomorrow I will teach you how to recognize the heat constitution so you may understand the full balance of the body.
